lead_html: F# Serenity is a scale by Reo Matsumoto for the Neotone Mutant: a ding, nine top-shell notes and nine mutant notes. Start with the three cards below: play each card's lit notes, then move to the next.
history_html: F# Serenity is a scale by Reo Matsumoto, shown in his video The Serenity Scale.
Reo Matsumoto is a handpan musician and beatboxer from Japan who teaches handpan workshops (Master the Handpan; Instruments du Monde).
On Master the Handpan he says he believes everything has spirit and plays with love and spirit. Instruments du Monde describes his music as music without borders that mixes genres.
